ArtifactRole.description: Role of an artifact within the Run.

oneOf.description: Original output of the external action.
A log of the producer or the action.
An external receipt, such as a signed execution statement.

ArtifactSource.description: Where an artifact's bytes come from.

oneOf.description: A closed file the recorder copies and verifies.

path.description:
Path to the file. The implementation defines which roots it may read.
[`LocalRecorder`](crate::LocalRecorder) reads only beneath the
workspace's configured `import_roots`: a relative path is tried
beneath each root in order, and an absolute path must lie beneath
one. No symlink is followed, and a file with more than one hard link
is refused. A path that no root holds is recorded as missing.

oneOf.description: The artifact was declared but is absent.

reason.description: Why it is absent, as reported.

from.description: Item key of the original on the same handle.

transform.description: Transform name and version, such as `text-extract/1`.

Position.description:
One-based position of an accepted item within a capture handle.

Appended facts and attachment descriptors share one sequence. The recorder
accepts only the next expected position, so a lost middle item is detectable.

description:
Descriptor of one completed artifact at the next position of a handle.

"Stable" is a producer obligation: the writer has closed and flushed the file.
The recorder still copies and verifies the bytes and rejects a file that
changes during the copy.

channel.description: Channel the artifact belongs to, if any.

classification.description: Classification; it may be stricter than the handle default, never looser.

derived_from.description: Earlier item this artifact derives from, for derivatives.

expected_digest.description: Digest the producer expects; a mismatch rejects the item.

expected_size_bytes.description: Size the producer expects; a mismatch rejects the item.

key.description: Producer item key, unique within the handle.

media_type.description: Media type hint. It is never used to choose a parser automatically.

position.description: The position the producer expects this item to take.

role.description: What the artifact is to the Run.

source.description: Where the bytes are, or why they are absent.

title: StableArtifact
